rationale: Reviewed full analysis-tool documentation delta against b223f10. The _TOOLS assignment and executable AST are unchanged, but four argument-class docstrings deliberately add top-level inputSchema descriptions to the actual emitted catalog. Fresh-process comparison proves these four descriptions are the only catalog changes: names, tool descriptions, fields, bounds, defaults, extra-field policy and dispatch constraints remain equal. New prose explains stable operation/job identities, byte-window reads and cancellation without task acceptance or credential selection. Seven native policy bodies and48business tool descriptions/schemas/annotations are unchanged. Existing authority/cancellation/receipt tests are directed runtime evidence, not model compliance, human comprehension or a fix for the failed budgeted delivery; DD157 remains deferred.
